To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Draft: football rundown for Monday admin meeting

Renee,

Here’s my rundown for the admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt’s board report.

We finished the regular season with a 31–14 win over Brookhollow. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and two touchdowns, including a long touchdown in the third quarter. On that whole drive, our line pushed their defense back about five yards. That was the best blocking I’ve seen from them all year. The defense held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half, and the win locked us into second in the region.

Deshawn Pettaway had three sacks and seven tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches had even met. That says a lot about the respect he’s earned from his teammates.

We host Clanton Valley in the first round of the playoffs Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please let Dr. Pruitt know it’s a home game and encourage folks to come out and support the team. The gate and chain crews still need confirming by Wednesday, and presale tickets start Tuesday. The boosters also need six more concession volunteers for the playoff game; the signup sheet is going out tomorrow.

The nine-week grade check came back clean: all 52 players are eligible, with nobody on the list. Tonya’s Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason those grades are in good shape, and she deserves the credit. She plans to keep it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale brought in $6,240 from 208 sales, beating the $4,500 goal. The money will go toward the new sideline headsets. Thanks to Hargrove’s Meat Market for smoking them at cost.

And I remember your note about transportation. If we win and go on the road, I’ll get the bus information to you in time for the five-day request window.

Please keep this as a draft for now—I’ll look it over between second and third period.
